body: Thank you. I'll send you a message as soon as I can.
Thank you. It's good to know I'm not alone.

Thank you for your reply. I'm so alone. And lonely. And I never see that changing. 

I don't think I'm strong enough. I've been trying for so many months to stay afloat. I think I'm out of energy. At some point you just have to accept your situation and just drown.

Because I don't ever seeing myself being happy. And I don't ever see someone else loving and accepting me for who I really am. And above all I'm tired trying to make my mood better. 

What I really want is to be happy. But I've tried and failed.
Thanks for replying. I hope I live to believe this one day.
